page.overview:
Who is Nico Hülkenberg?

Nicolas "Nico" Hülkenberg (born 19 August 1987 in Emmerich am Rhein, North Rhine-Westphalia, West Germany) is a German driver racing. currently competing in the Formula One for Kick Sauber. He started at Williams in where he scored his maiden pole position at the , then moved to Force India where he spent as a test driver before promotion to a race seat in . During the race at 2012 Brazilian Grand Prix, he took his first fastest lap, and achieved another at the 2016 Chinese Grand Prix.

He moved to Sauber for a season in , before in , he returned to Force India, retaining his seat in . In , he got his second front row start, in Austria.

His permanent number in his F1 career is #27.

On 14th October 2016, it was announced that he signed for Renault for the season. Following the 2019 season, he was replaced by Esteban Ocon at Renault.
